title: "Differential Gene Expression Analysis - MDD"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
    number_sections: true
---
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
counts_file   <- snakemake@input$counts
samplesheet_f <- snakemake@input$samplesheet
SEX_TO_ANALYZE <- "male"

library(data.table)
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(ggrepel)
```

# Input data
```{r load-counts}
count_matrix_full <- read.table(gzfile(counts_file), header=TRUE,
                                row.names=NULL, sep="\t", check.names=FALSE)
rownames(count_matrix_full) <- make.unique(as.character(count_matrix_full[,1]))
count_matrix_full <- count_matrix_full[,-1]
cat("Full matrix dimensions:", dim(count_matrix_full), "\n")
```
```{r filter-input-cols}
count_matrix <- count_matrix_full[, grepl("input", colnames(count_matrix_full))]
colnames(count_matrix) <- gsub("_input", "", colnames(count_matrix))
colnames(count_matrix) <- gsub("__", "_", colnames(count_matrix))
cat("Input-only matrix dimensions:", dim(count_matrix), "\n")
```
```{r load-samplesheet}
samplesheet <- fread(samplesheet_f)
samplesheet_sex <- samplesheet[samplesheet$sex == SEX_TO_ANALYZE, ]
matched <- samplesheet_sex$sample[samplesheet_sex$sample %in% colnames(count_matrix)]
samplesheet_sex <- samplesheet_sex[samplesheet_sex$sample %in% matched, ]
count_matrix_sex <- count_matrix[, matched]
samplesheet_sex$condition <- relevel(factor(samplesheet_sex$condition), ref = "control")
cat("Sample groups:\n")
print(table(samplesheet_sex$condition))
```
```{r create-dds}
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = count_matrix_sex,
                               colData = samplesheet_sex, design = ~ condition)
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 2
dds_filt <- dds[keep, ]
cat("Genes after filtering:", nrow(dds_filt), "\n")
```

# Data exploration

## Raw counts
```{r boxplot-raw}
melted <- reshape2::melt(as.matrix(counts(dds_filt)),
                         varnames=c("Gene","ID"), value.name="Count")
ggplot(melted, aes(x=ID, y=Count, fill=ID)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size=0.2, show.legend=FALSE) + theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, hjust=1, size=7)) +
  ggtitle(paste0("Raw counts - ", SEX_TO_ANALYZE))
```

## VST
```{r vst}
vsd <- vst(dds_filt, blind=FALSE)
melted_vsd <- reshape2::melt(as.matrix(assay(vsd)),
                              varnames=c("Gene","ID"), value.name="Count")
ggplot(melted_vsd, aes(x=ID, y=Count, fill=ID)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size=0.2, show.legend=FALSE) + theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, hjust=1, size=7)) +
  ggtitle(paste0("VST counts - ", SEX_TO_ANALYZE))
```

## Dispersion
```{r dispersion}
dds_filt <- estimateSizeFactors(dds_filt)
dds_filt <- estimateDispersions(dds_filt)
plotDispEsts(dds_filt)
```

## PCA
```{r pca}
plotPCA(vsd, intgroup="condition") + theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("control"="#2166AC","MDD"="#D6604D")) +
  ggtitle(paste0("PCA - ", SEX_TO_ANALYZE)) +
  theme(legend.title=element_blank())
```

## Top 500 heatmap
```{r heatmap-top500}
vars <- apply(assay(vsd), 1, var)
top500 <- names(sort(vars, decreasing=TRUE))[1:500]
mat <- assay(vsd)[top500,]
ann_col <- as.data.frame(colData(vsd)[,"condition",drop=FALSE])
pheatmap::pheatmap(mat, scale="row", show_rownames=FALSE,
  annotation_col=ann_col,
  annotation_colors=list(condition=c(control="#2166AC",MDD="#D6604D")),
  main=paste0("Top 500 variable genes - ", SEX_TO_ANALYZE),
  cluster_cols=TRUE, fontsize_col=7)
```

## Sample distances
```{r heatmap-dist}
sampleDists <- dist(t(assay(vsd)))
sampleDistMatrix <- as.matrix(sampleDists)
rownames(sampleDistMatrix) <- paste(colnames(vsd), vsd$condition, sep=" - ")
colnames(sampleDistMatrix) <- NULL
colors <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(9,"Blues")))(255)
pheatmap(sampleDistMatrix, clustering_distance_rows=sampleDists,
  clustering_distance_cols=sampleDists, col=colors,
  main=paste0("Sample distances - ", SEX_TO_ANALYZE), fontsize_row=7)
```

# Differential gene expression
```{r run-deseq2}
dds_filt <- DESeq(dds_filt)
res <- results(dds_filt, contrast=c("condition","MDD","control"), alpha=0.05)
summary(res)
resLFC <- lfcShrink(dds_filt, coef="condition_MDD_vs_control", type="apeglm")
```
```{r sig-genes}
sig_genes <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  filter(!is.na(pvalue), pvalue < 0.05, abs(log2FoldChange) > log2(1.2))
cat("Total DEGs:", nrow(sig_genes), "\n")
cat("Up:", sum(sig_genes$log2FoldChange > 0), "\n")
cat("Down:", sum(sig_genes$log2FoldChange < 0), "\n")
```

## Top 10 DEGs
```{r top10}
top_genes <- sig_genes %>% arrange(pvalue) %>% head(10)
print(top_genes[, c("gene","baseMean","log2FoldChange","pvalue","padj")])
```

## Count plots
```{r count-plots, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
par(mfrow=c(3,3))
for(g in top_genes$gene[1:min(9,nrow(top_genes))]) {
  tryCatch(plotCounts(dds_filt, gene=g, intgroup="condition", main=g,
                      col=c("#2166AC","#D6604D")), error=function(e) NULL)
}
par(mfrow=c(1,1))
```

## Volcano plot
```{r volcano, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>% filter(!is.na(pvalue)) %>%
  mutate(significant = pvalue < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > log2(1.2))

ggplot(res_df, aes(x=log2FoldChange, y=-log10(pvalue), color=significant)) +
  geom_point(size=0.8, alpha=0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("FALSE"="grey70","TRUE"="#D6604D")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(-log2(1.2),log2(1.2)), linetype="dashed", linewidth=0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.05), linetype="dashed", linewidth=0.3) +
  xlim(-4,4) + theme_bw() + theme(legend.title=element_blank()) +
  labs(title=paste0("Volcano - ", SEX_TO_ANALYZE, " MDD vs control"),
       subtitle=paste0(nrow(sig_genes), " DEGs (p<0.05, FC>1.2)"),
       x="Log2 Fold Change", y="-log10(p-value)")
```

# Pathway analysis
```{r gsea, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

msig_human <- msigdbr::msigdbr(species="Homo sapiens", category="C5") %>%
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol) %>% dplyr::distinct()
pathways <- split(msig_human$gene_symbol, msig_human$gs_name)

rank_tbl <- as.data.frame(res) %>% rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  filter(!is.na(pvalue), !is.na(log2FoldChange)) %>%
  mutate(rank_stat = -log10(pvalue) * sign(log2FoldChange))
ranks <- setNames(rank_tbl$rank_stat, rank_tbl$gene)
ranks <- sort(ranks, decreasing=TRUE)

set.seed(1)
fg <- fgsea(pathways=pathways, stats=ranks, minSize=15, maxSize=500) %>%
  as_tibble() %>% arrange(pval)
print(head(fg[,c("pathway","NES","pval","padj")], 20))
```

## Dotplot
```{r dotplot, fig.width=14, fig.height=7}
top_pos <- fg %>% filter(NES>0, pval<0.05) %>% slice_max(NES, n=15)
top_neg <- fg %>% filter(NES<0, pval<0.05) %>% slice_min(NES, n=15)
top_p <- bind_rows(top_pos, top_neg) %>% arrange(NES)

if(nrow(top_p) == 0) {
  top_p <- bind_rows(fg %>% filter(NES>0) %>% slice_max(NES,n=10),
                     fg %>% filter(NES<0) %>% slice_min(NES,n=10)) %>% arrange(NES)
}

top_p$pathway_short <- str_trunc(gsub("GOBP_|GOCC_|GOMF_","",top_p$pathway), 55)

ggplot(top_p, aes(x=NES, y=reorder(pathway_short,NES),
                   size=-log10(pval), color=NES>0)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("TRUE"="#2166AC","FALSE"="#D6604D"),
    labels=c("TRUE"="Upregulated","FALSE"="Downregulated")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="grey50") +
  labs(x="NES", y="Pathway",
       title=paste0("GSEA - ", SEX_TO_ANALYZE, " MDD vs control")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y=element_text(size=7), legend.title=element_blank())
```

# Male vs Female comparison
```{r comparison, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Reload FULL count matrix for both sexes
count_matrix_all <- read.table(gzfile(counts_file), header=TRUE,
                               row.names=NULL, sep="\t", check.names=FALSE)
rownames(count_matrix_all) <- make.unique(as.character(count_matrix_all[,1]))
count_matrix_all <- count_matrix_all[,-1]
count_matrix_all <- count_matrix_all[, grepl("input", colnames(count_matrix_all))]
colnames(count_matrix_all) <- gsub("_input","", colnames(count_matrix_all))
colnames(count_matrix_all) <- gsub("__","_", colnames(count_matrix_all))

run_deseq_sex <- function(sex, cm_full, ss_full) {
  ss  <- ss_full[ss_full$sex == sex, ]
  matched <- ss$sample[ss$sample %in% colnames(cm_full)]
  ss  <- ss[ss$sample %in% matched, ]
  cm  <- cm_full[, matched]
  ss$condition <- relevel(factor(ss$condition), ref="control")
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=cm, colData=ss, design=~condition)
  keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 2
  dds <- dds[keep,]
  dds <- DESeq(dds, quiet=TRUE)
  res <- results(dds, contrast=c("condition","MDD","control"), alpha=0.05)
  sig <- as.data.frame(res) %>% rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    filter(!is.na(pvalue), pvalue<0.05, abs(log2FoldChange)>log2(1.2))
  cat(sex, "- n samples:", nrow(ss), "| DEGs:", nrow(sig),
      "| Up:", sum(sig$log2FoldChange>0),
      "| Down:", sum(sig$log2FoldChange<0), "\n")
  list(res=res, sig=sig)
}

samplesheet_all <- fread(samplesheet_f)
res_male   <- run_deseq_sex("male",   count_matrix_all, samplesheet_all)
res_female <- run_deseq_sex("female", count_matrix_all, samplesheet_all)

shared      <- intersect(res_male$sig$gene, res_female$sig$gene)
only_male   <- setdiff(res_male$sig$gene,   res_female$sig$gene)
only_female <- setdiff(res_female$sig$gene, res_male$sig$gene)
cat("Shared:", length(shared), "| Male-only:", length(only_male),
    "| Female-only:", length(only_female), "\n")
only_female <- setdiff(res_female$sig$gene, res_male$sig$gene)
cat("Shared:", length(shared), "| Male-only:", length(only_male),
    "| Female-only:", length(only_female), "\n")
```

## DEG count barplot
```{r barplot-comparison}
deg_summary <- data.frame(
  Sex = rep(c("Male","Female"), each=2),
  Direction = rep(c("Upregulated","Downregulated"), 2),
  Count = c(sum(res_male$sig$log2FoldChange>0),
            sum(res_male$sig$log2FoldChange<0),
            sum(res_female$sig$log2FoldChange>0),
            sum(res_female$sig$log2FoldChange<0))
)
ggplot(deg_summary, aes(x=Sex, y=Count, fill=Direction)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position="dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("Upregulated"="#D6604D","Downregulated"="#2166AC"), labels=c("Upregulated"="Upregulated (MDD > ctrl)","Downregulated"="Downregulated (MDD < ctrl)")) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs( y="Number of DEGs", x="") +
  theme(legend.title=element_blank())
```

## Side-by-side volcano
```{r volcano-comparison, fig.width=14, fig.height=5}
make_v <- function(res, sex) {
  as.data.frame(res) %>% rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    filter(!is.na(pvalue)) %>%
    mutate(sex=sex, sig=pvalue<0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange)>log2(1.2))
}
v_both <- bind_rows(make_v(res_male$res,"Male"), make_v(res_female$res,"Female"))

ggplot(v_both, aes(x=log2FoldChange, y=-log10(pvalue), color=sig)) +
  geom_point(size=0.6, alpha=0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("FALSE"="grey70","TRUE"="#D6604D")) +
  facet_wrap(~sex) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(-log2(1.2),log2(1.2)), linetype="dashed", linewidth=0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.05), linetype="dashed", linewidth=0.3) +
  xlim(-4,4) + theme_bw() + theme(legend.title=element_blank()) +
  labs(title="MDD vs Control - Male and Female comparison",
       x="Log2 Fold Change", y="-log10(p-value)")
```
